title: Why ChatGPT Plus Doesn't Get OpenAI Dots Yet #shorts
description:
OpenAI dots are gradually rolling out to eligible Pro and Business Premium users. Enterprise access, including Edu, is a beta controlled by workspace administrators; the standard Plus plan is not in the announced eligible tiers. Availability depends on account and region. Your dot doesn't automatically receive every connected-app permission; sensitive actions may still need approval.

Would you start with EMAIL or a TO-DO LIST?
Sources: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001530-getting-started-with-your-dot
